change.summary: Added a GTK2 toggle-specific adapter using KDE Window/WindowText roles, shallow native geometry, and a flat face for persistent and armed states. This matches the local indicator-less Motif sample after focus leaves; GTK2 Pixmap cannot distinguish persistent ACTIVE from armed ACTIVE, so it cannot express separate relief for those states.
change.tests: 12 targeted tests passed across GTK2 push/toggle/combo/spin; py_compile and git diff --check passed. All test temporary directories were under ~/tempia.

results.captures: 44 captures: 11 states per palette; native click/release worked and disabled input was blocked in every palette.
results.pixel_check: 44/44 scoped checks passed; 0 edge differences; face matched the Window role. Text antialiasing was measured separately from the face.
results.local_motif_reference: The Theme Lab local XmToggleButton sample requests 56×21 px. Idle and selected after focus moves are pixel-identical; the focused capture differs by a black focus outline (292 pixels). This is a local sample, not a metric or screenshot from the SR10.4 VM.

limits: No direct visual capture from the SR10.4 guest was taken for this control.
The GTK2 toggle-specific recipe is technically validated; GTK2 as a whole remains incomplete.
No session theme, XChat process, Xephyr, or user preference was changed.
next: Continue with the GTK2 check control as one isolated family; radio remains a separate later step. Apply GTK2 to the user session and XChat only after the complete GTK2 adapter scope is finished.
